name: Radiative Transfer Equation Formulation
aliases: Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) for Participating Media
definition: The time-dependent radiative transport equation expressed in units of length $s$ (where $s=vt$), describing light transport in arbitrary media.
summary: The Radiative Transfer Equation is a differential equation governing light transport in participating media, distinguished by explicitly handling volumetric scattering rather than surface interactions.
